strips.title: The keys, the bag, the flight — an AirTag 2 week

panels.head: 7:50 AM — where are the keys?
panels.text: Tap Play Sound. The new chime is about 50% louder. Second cushion from the left.

panels.head: Arrows from across the room
panels.text: Precision Finding shows a distance and an arrow, now from much farther away.

panels.head: Checked bag, tight connection
panels.text: Share Item Location sends the airline a link to where your bag actually is.

panels.head: $20 a tag, a year a battery
panels.text: Buy the 4-pack under $80. Keys, wallet, suitcase, kid.
